attributes.action: Make Mental Health Awareness & Response Training Compulsory in All UK Schools
attributes.background: Require compulsory mental health training for all school staff in England. Staff should recognise distress, respond appropriately, use calming techniques, provide access to a quiet safe space, and ensure no child feels dismissed or ignored when asking for help.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/752343
